title: castalia candida
intro: Castalia candida, commonly known as White Castalia or Queen of the Night, is a species of flowering plant that belongs to the family Arum. The plant is native to the tropical regions of Central and South America and has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits. The health benefits of Castalia candida include its ability to treat fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues, while its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of Castalia candida include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
